{{Quote|We are united in a single cause&mdash;the complete and utter destruction of the Republic.|Kelad'den|<ref name="RoT" />}}
The '''Anti-Republic Liberation Front''', also known as the '''ARLF''' by its members, was a small group of revolutionary separatists who were dedicated to overthrowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|defeat]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hetton]] founded the group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It gathered a variety of beings dissatisfied with the Galactic Republic's policies and influence on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], particularly on Serenno, and formed them into an organized group that could effectively combine their resources and use them to damage the Republic. Financing itself through several rich and powerful members of upper-class families on Serenno, including Hetton, who was related to one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], the Anti-Republic Liberation Front was extremely cautious when admitting new members to their ranks. The group was ambitious, and they chose high profile targets in the hopes of doing as much damage to the Republic as possible.

In [[990 BBY]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the only [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] to survive the [[Thought bomb|destruction]] of the Brotherhood, infiltrated a small band of Anti-Republic Liberation Front members and convinced them to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. Several members of the group [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|ambushed]] Valorum outside the [[Nalju family estate|estate]] of the [[House Nalju/Legends|Nalju family]], one of the six Great Houses, but the attempt failed due to the interference of [[Johun Othone]], Valorum's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. After their failure, Zannah was detained and taken by two of the surviving assassins to meet Hetton personally. Impressed by the combat techniques and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Force abilities]] she used to incapacitate two of his soldiers, Hetton believed that he would become Zannah's apprentice if he helped her [[Death/Legends|kill]] her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], and he accompanied her back to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] camp on the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. However, upon their arrival at the camp, Zannah abandoned Hetton; without her help, he could not [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|defeat]] Bane and was subsequently killed. Bane and Zannah dismantled the group shortly after Hetton's death.

==Description==
The Anti-Republic Liberation Front was formed to oppose the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its policies. The methods used by the group to achieve their goals were often violent, and their plans were formulated with the goal of gaining the attention of their enemies, so that they would be recognized as a serious threat and so that other revolutionary groups would be inspired to directly oppose the Republic.<ref name="RoT" />

Many members of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front were wealthy and willing to use their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] to fund the organization. The group's collective wealth allowed it to purchase high-quality weapons and equipment, including explosives, and some members used specialized weapons suited to their particular combat style, such as the [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kelad'den]]'s [[Unidentified crescent-shaped weapon|crescent-shaped blades]]. Hetton owned a collection of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], though he did not let the other members of the group know about his collection. The organization was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Its members worked out of several locations in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]], including the basement of a [[Unidentified cantina (Carannia)|cantina]], as well as [[Hetton's family estate]], which was located in a region directly outside Carannia.<ref name="RoT" />

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|We must find a target that will make the entire galaxy sit up and take notice!|Kelad'den|<ref name="RoT" />}}
At some point prior to [[990 BBY]], after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|destruction]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] on the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], [[Hetton]]&mdash;a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was distantly related to [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]]&mdash;formed a group called the Anti-Republic Liberation Front. He gathered followers with skills and talents that he considered unique, all of whom were dissatisfied with the influence of the Galactic Republic and its policies on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and wanted to actively work toward its destruction. They argued that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was incapable of acting on the behalf of the galaxy, particularly after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], a policy that planned to reduce the millions of [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the Republic to 1024. They also argued that other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] should become independent and secede from the Republic.<ref name="CSWE" /> The structure of the group allowed its members to combine their strength, resources, and power into a single organized collective that could effectively damage the Republic through plans that utilized all the available resources, thus improving their probability of success. They were ambitious, and targeted high-profile targets to attack in the hopes of gaining the attention of their enemies.<ref name="RoT" />

Hetton had been trained in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] from an early age by [[Gula Dwan]], a Force-sensitive [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and though he did not have any actual [[Sith training]], he still hoped to destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as well as the Galactic Republic. While doing so, he believed that any living [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would come to his aid. For Hetton, the group provided a useful cover for his other goal: the resurrection of the Sith Order.<ref name="CSWE" /> Even though he was the founder of an organization that uniformly despised both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Republic, Hetton did not reveal his personal goals to his followers in the Anti-Republic Liberation Front, as he was wary of what their response would be.<ref name="RoT" />

===Assassination attempt on Valorum===
{{Quote|He is responsible for everything we are fighting against, the symbol of everything we wish to destroy.|Kelad'den, referring to Tarsus Valorum|<ref name="RoT" />}}
[[File:DarthZannah-DoE.png|thumb|left|135px|Darth Zannah, the Sith who infiltrated the ARLF]]
In 990 BBY, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]&mdash;[[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the only [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] to survive the [[Thought bomb|destruction]] of the Brotherhood of Darkness and the founder of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], a doctrine that allowed only two Sith to live at any one [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;was tasked by her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] with the infiltration of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front for the purpose of goading them into a premature attack on the Republic. The mission was part of a plan to destroy any groups that Bane believed had the potential to damage the Republic before he wanted it to be destroyed, as well as to waste the resources of the Republic and the Jedi&mdash;moves that would draw their attention away from the Sith. Under the pseudonym "Rainah," Zannah became the lover of a high-ranking Twi'lek, Kelad'den, which earned her the support of a trusted group member. In order to convince Kelad'den that she could be useful to the group, she told him that she was employed as an administrative assistant at the Republic embassy. After several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of persuasion, he agreed to let her come to one of the group's meetings.<ref name="RoT" />

Hetton tasked Kelad'den with kidnapping several public officials during the annual [[Armistice Celebrations]] held to commemorate the anniversary of the Ruusan Reformations. However, because of Zannah's manipulation, Kelad'den believed that more damage would be done if they instead assassinated the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], who was scheduled to land at the private [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[House Nalju/Legends|Nalju family]], located at their [[Nalju family estate|estate]]. Kelad'den believed that Valorum had come to Serenno to persuade the Great Houses to directly oppose separatist groups such as their own.<ref name="RoT" />

The [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek took three [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to assist him in his [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|mission]], as well as [[Cyndra]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] female assigned to plant explosives on the landing pad, and [[Paak]], a Human male who would [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] that the assassins were to use as an escape vehicle. Disguised as [[Nalju]] staff, the assassins waited on the landing pad for Valorum and his Jedi [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Johun Othone]]. When he approached the assassins, Othone realized the danger that the "staff" posed and managed to prevent the former Chancellor from falling to his [[Death/Legends|death]] off of the small, windswept platform that they were standing on when Cyndra detonated the explosives. The Jedi then killed two of the support soldiers as Kelad'den killed the third for attempting to escape the fight. Cyndra and Paak escaped in the landspeeder to report back to Hetton, leaving Kelad'den to fight the Jedi alone, a duel which Kelad'den lost.<ref name="RoT" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|It won't be long before the Great Houses discover I am the founder of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front. They will seize my assets and declare me a traitor.|Hetton, explaining to Zannah his situation after the failed assassination attempt|<ref name="RoT" />}}
A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after the failed assassination attempt, Cyndra found Zannah in a Carannia marketplace. She and Paak then escorted Zannah to Hetton's estate as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] so that Hetton could question Zannah and determine if she had influenced Kelad'den's decision. When Zannah saw Hetton, she sensed that he had been trained in the use of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After a display of [[Summon fear|power]] in which she drove Cyndra insane and murdered Paak, Hetton showed her his collection of Sith artifacts, as well as his eight personal [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]]s, and asked that she let him become her apprentice. Shortly afterward, Zannah escorted Hetton and his assassins to the Sith camp on the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] under the pretense that they would work together to kill [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane. Upon their arrival to the camp, Zannah betrayed Hetton, and without her assistance, Hetton and his assassins were quickly [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|defeated]] and killed, an act which effectively destroyed the Anti-Republic Liberation Front.<ref name="RoT" /> Shortly after Hetton's death, Bane and Zannah dismantled what was left of the group.<ref name="CSWE" />
[[File:Serenno-TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|Serenno, the Anti-Republic Liberation Front's base of operations]]

==Members==
{{Quote|I drew those individuals with unique skills and talents into my service.|Hetton|<ref name="RoT" />}}
The Anti-Republic Liberation Front consisted, for the most part, of beings who had some kind of political, financial, or military power. The group's ranks were filled by an unusually high proportion of beings with advanced military experience and training compared to other organizations of similar population. Many group members believed themselves to be heroes, or perhaps eventual martyrs to their cause, which they were all extremely passionate about. Gaining membership to the group was difficult, as current members were highly cautious; Zannah was forced to wait several months before she was allowed to attend a meeting, even though she was intimately connected with Kelad'den, a high-ranking member. They did not discriminate against [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], and allowed beings from all [[Species/Legends|species]] and sexes to join, including the Chiss female Cyndra and the Twi'lek male Kelad'den.<ref name="RoT" />

Hetton had the social status and money to keep the group protected and well armed, though he still preferred to hire those with their own funds, such as Kelad'den. The latter was both rich and skilled in combat, and he was placed in charge of the mission to kidnap local officials. He felt that Hetton's plans were not infallible, and he would alter them if he considered doing so the best thing to do. Cyndra and Paak did not agree with Kelad'den's disobedience; they believed that all missions that Hetton gave them should be followed exactly, and not altered. Such differences in ideology caused frequent arguments between the three.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Anti-Republic Liberation Front was featured in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published in [[2007]].<ref name="RoT" />
